title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_lekker_bezig_by_liz_pichon_scqvm (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_lekker_bezig_by_liz_pichon_scqvm' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package can lead to full system compromise, including potential theft of secrets and keys stored on the affected machine.
